links.outcome: Radiology professionals' self-reported AI knowledge, training adequacy, and barriers to AI implementation
links.effect: 58.6% reported limited AI knowledge and inadequate training; 43.6% identified skill development and the complexity of AI educational programs as major barriers to implementation.
links.quote: However, 58.6% reported limited AI knowledge and inadequate training, with 43.6% identifying skill development and the complexity of AI educational programs as major barriers to implementation.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey evaluating radiology professionals' awareness, acceptance, knowledge, and educational/training needs regarding AI adoption in clinical practice.
